name: Monaco 3 Seater Fabric Sofa in Indigo Blue

description.mood_line: A poised anchor of indigo elegance grounds your living room.
description.intro: The Monaco 3‑Seater Fabric Sofa presents a clean Scandinavian silhouette anchored by solid‑wood construction.
description.story: Upholstered in a textured poly‑cotton fabric, the sofa offers a subtle tactile depth in a rich indigo hue. Its solid‑wood frame is reinforced with precision joinery and tapered legs that reinforce the minimalist profile. Measuring 210 cm wide, 90 cm deep and 85 cm high, it establishes a balanced visual anchor within the living space.
description.close: Together, the Monaco set anchors your lounge with understated, architectural calm.

name: Solano L Shaped Solid Sheesham Wood Sofa Set with Chaise

description.mood_line: Anchor your living room with the sculptural presence of Solano.
description.intro: The Solano L‑shaped sofa set establishes a solid seating anchor for the living space.
description.story: Crafted from solid Sheesham wood, the frame showcases exposed grain joinery and wide slatted armrests, finished in a honey‑teak tone that grounds the space. The cotton duck upholstery offers a textured surface over supportive cushions, arranged across a 1.60 m × 2.45 m × 0.80 m footprint to accommodate five guests in an L‑shaped layout.
description.close: Together, Solano anchors the room’s flow, turning everyday lounging into a measured, welcoming experience.
